snippet.title: Heroes Unhinged - New Trailer
snippet.description:
Heroes Unhinged now has a demo available on Steam!  Download now to experience 4 of the heroes and 2 of the stages!  Progress will carry over to the full release!

🎮 Download Demo and Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561240/Heroes_Unhinged/
